name: 33991 · Cape Coral, FL
findings: ZIP 33991 (Cape Coral) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33991 (Cape Coral) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33991 (Cape Coral) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32% of the typical level).
